name: Do custom landscape planters require building permits in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: Do custom landscape planters require building permits in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a custom landscape planter requires a building permit in Los Angeles County depends on its size, height, and specific location on the property. Generally, smaller, at-grade planters or those below a certain height (often 30 inches above grade) may not require a permit. However, larger, elevated, or structurally significant planters, especially those near property lines, integrated with retaining walls, or involving complex plumbing/electrical work, typically do. It's always best practice to consult with us during the design phase to determine if your project necessitates a permit and to ensure compliance with local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit requirements for custom planters in Los Angeles County depend on size, height, and location. Larger or complex planters often require permits.
